title: URAファイナルズ決勝にむけて

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I've been waiting for you, Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: That face of yours tells me you are ready for a challenge… Good! That is exactly what I want to see.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Take heed! I have but one piece of advice for you.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Believe in your trainee's strength and seize victory together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The URA Finale… At long last, the gates will open to the finals!
